description: This Java class 'PolicyIdReferencePlaceholderResolver' is responsible for resolving policy IDs of referenced entities, particularly of type 'THINGS', by querying related services via Akka patterns, handling responses and exceptions, and supporting specific entity types within the project.

classes.name: PolicyIdReferencePlaceholderResolver
classes.description: Handles resolution of policy IDs for referenced entities, primarily for entities of type THINGS, using Akka messaging to retrieve entity data and process responses, with configurable timeouts.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the policy ID of an entity based on its placeholder information, selecting the appropriate strategy based on entity type, and performing asynchronous retrieval.

methods.name: handlePolicyIdReference
methods.description: Performs an entity lookup via an Akka ask pattern, returning a stage that contains the policy ID or throwing exceptions on failure.
